tools.name: open_shorty
tools.title: Open Shorty Studio
tools.description: Open the complete Shorty editor inside ChatGPT: browse reference/effect templates, upload footage, review edits and revise selected objects. This only opens a view; it never starts paid work. Use the current shortySelection context for project/edit identifiers. The website uses its own Shorty sign-in; connect the same account for private context sharing. Studio submits requests to ChatGPT: you must inspect and author the composition yourself with authoring_contract and author_edit, then render its planRevisionId. For revisions read editor_session and preserve the existing source/media bindings. Never use backend autopilot or revise_edit for Studio requests.

tools.name: choose_reference
tools.title: Choose a reference video to copy
tools.description: OPTIONAL STEP 1. Upload the reference video whose editing style Shorty will copy: a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, or X post link, a direct media URL, or a local file path. Post links are resolved to the underlying video for callers with credits. Hosted callers passing a path get back a one-line signed upload command to run (with a shell tool, or pasted by the user); stdio reads the path directly. Creates the edit project and publishes the reference as an immutable asset. Skip it to edit without a reference — start with add_footage instead.

source.description: A TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, or X post link, a direct media URL (.mp4, .mov, ...), or a local file path in stdio mode. Post links are resolved to the underlying video; if a platform blocks it, the user uploads their own copy instead.

project.description: Optional project name. Defaults to a stable name derived from the source, so repeating the same reference reuses one project.

upload.description: Signed, short-lived upload instructions for media on the caller's device.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

annotations.title: Choose a reference video to copy

tools.name: add_footage
tools.title: Add your footage to the edit
tools.description: STEP 2. Upload the user's own clips into the edit project. Accepts post links (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X), direct media URLs, and local file paths; URL uploads run in parallel, and hosted callers passing paths get back one signed upload command per file to run (with a shell tool, or pasted by the user). Omit projectId to start a reference-less edit — a project is created automatically.

projectId.description: Project from choose_reference. Omit to auto-create a project for a reference-less edit.

kind.description: Default footage. Use music for a soundtrack, other for sound effects or masks.

sources.description: Post links (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X), direct media URLs, or local file paths in stdio mode.

tools.name: render
tools.title: Render the finished video
tools.description: Render an accepted immutable planRevisionId from author_edit at full scale. Reserves credits and creates a video artifact. A failed matching render may be retried automatically. Resume or collect the video with status.

wait.description: Wait for completion and deliver the video. Defaults to true. Hosted authored renders wait up to 60 seconds, then return a renderJobId for status; wait=false returns immediately.

tools.name: status

tools.description: Open one durable edit run or authored render job in the render monitor: inspect it, wait for it, and deliver its finished video. Requires exactly one of editRunId or renderJobId; to find runs, inspect the project with the get_project tool instead. Status never starts or retries a job.

editRunId.description: Edit run to open. Pass this or renderJobId.

renderJobId.description: Authored render job to open. Pass this or editRunId.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

tools.name: ground_visual_entities
tools.title: ground visual entities
tools.description: Measure semantic boxes, centers, landmarks or planar surface corners in a still image or up to eight exact video frames. Supply named entities, landmarks and a question. Returns immutable normalized geometry for composition authoring. Uses immutable assetId in projectId. Read media_contract for worker limits and pricing. Starts a paid durable job; use job to inspect progress. Preserves source assets.

geometryKind.description: Use planar_surface only for exact four-corner receiving-surface geometry.

timestampsSeconds.description: Exact source timestamps selected from prior video inspection. Omit for a static image.

id.description: Stable id used unchanged across every requested frame.

description.description: Pixel-grounded identity, e.g. screen-left hand belonging to the main person.

name.description: Stable landmark name returned for every entity.

description.description: Exact point definition, e.g. midpoint between visible thumb and index fingertips.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

tools.name: measure_motion
tools.title: measure motion
tools.description: Measure non-semantic pixel displacement of an already identified rectangle over a bounded source interval. Returns numeric patch-motion measurements. Does not recognize or locate semantic entities. Uses immutable assetId in projectId. Read media_contract for worker limits and pricing. Starts a paid durable job; use job to inspect progress. Preserves source assets.

templateFrame.description: Which frame of the range supplies the template. Use last to track an object backwards from where it settles — the only way to measure how it arrived, since at its first frame it is not there yet.

x.description: Left edge of the tracked rectangle, 0..1 from the left.

y.description: Top edge of the tracked rectangle, 0..1 from the top.

width.description: Rectangle width as a fraction of frame width.

height.description: Rectangle height as a fraction of frame height.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

tools.name: compose_spatial_text
tools.title: compose spatial text
tools.description: Create transparent video of authorized text inside or behind measured scene geometry over an exact source interval. Choose font, styling, anchor, masking and motion controls. Returns a derived alpha-video asset. Uses immutable assetId in projectId. Read media_contract for worker limits and pricing. Starts a paid durable job; use job to inspect progress. Preserves source assets.

text.description: Final authorized display text, at most 160 characters.

fontFamily.description: One family from the supplied renderable font catalog.

fontSize.description: Reference font size in source-video pixels.

x.description: Normalized reference text centre in the complete source frame.

y.description: Normalized reference text centre in the complete source frame.

maskMode.description: inside keeps text only in the SAM region (for outdoor view through windows); behind removes text inside the SAM region (for a foreground person or object).

prompt.description: Precise visible region/object phrase. Comma-separate multiple object classes only when needed.

frameIndex.description: Frame relative to the extracted interval, where 0 is sourceStartSeconds.
Frame relative to the extracted interval.

detectionThreshold.description: SAM detection threshold 0..1. Start around 0.25–0.35 for a difficult semantic region; raise only when false positives remain.

maskInset.description: Shrink an inside mask away from real edges, 0..12 source pixels.

temporalRadius.description: Temporal majority radius 0..2; 1 is the stable default.

objectSeedBox.description: Required for follow-object. Normalized bbox of the moving object on objectSeedFrame; a deterministic KLT median-flow track then drives per-frame text translation and scale while SAM still controls visibility.

objectSeedFrame.description: Frame relative to the interval where objectSeedBox is drawn; the track runs both directions from it.

cameraTrackRegion.description: Required for camera-track. Normalized static scene region near the desired virtual text depth; exclude independently moving content.

cameraFocalLengthPixels.description: Optional known focal length in source pixels. Omit to let OpenSfM/Ceres refine focal length.

cameraDepthQuantile.description: Virtual plane depth within the solved cameraTrackRegion point cloud: 0 nearest, 0.5 median, 1 farthest. Defaults to 0.5.

cameraDepthScale.description: 3D Z-offset multiplier after choosing point-cloud depth: below 1 places text nearer to camera, above 1 farther. This changes real 3D parallax, not a manual scale curve.

smoothCameraTrajectory.description: Remove subpixel solve noise while preserving the reference frame; defaults true.

translationStrength.description: 0 ignores noisy SAM centre translation while preserving scale; use 1 only for a real measured pan.

translationStrengthY.description: Optional independent vertical follow strength 0..1. Keep 0 when inspection shows no real tilt/pedestal.

scaleStart.description: Optional measured text scale at interval start, 0.25..4. Must be paired with scaleEnd; use for a full-frame wall/arch mask whose bbox cannot reveal zoom.

scaleEnd.description: Optional measured text scale at interval end, 0.25..4. Must be measured from visible scene geometry, not guessed.

referenceFrame.description: Frame relative to the interval used as scale 1 and the authored anchor.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

tools.name: track_object
tools.title: track object
tools.description: Track one rigid moving object named by a literal prompt over an exact shot-bounded source interval, up to 512 frames. Returns motion keyframes and a source block for attaching composition layers. Use semantic grounding for deformable subjects. Uses immutable assetId in projectId. Read media_contract for worker limits and pricing. Starts a paid durable job; use job to inspect progress. Preserves source assets.

prompt.description: One concise literal text prompt naming the complete moving object, for example: the red car.

seedFrame.description: Optional interval frame expected to visibly contain the prompted object; used to select the correct contiguous SAM run.

referenceFrame.description: Optional interval frame treated as scale 1 and offset 0. Defaults to seedFrame or the first covered frame.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

tools.name: inspect
tools.title: Watch project media as contact sheets
tools.description: DIRECTOR STEP 1. Watch the project's media: returns contact-sheet images sampled at an exact cadence (default 10fps, the backend analyzer's cadence) plus duration, dimensions, and audio facts. Adaptive workflow: first pass the whole clip at 10fps; if adjacent tiles show fast cuts, whip transitions, or beat flashes you cannot place precisely, re-inspect JUST that section with fps up to 24 and a startSec/endSec window. Each sheet is labeled with its exact time range; tiles read left-to-right, top-to-bottom at 1/fps seconds per tile.

assetIds.description: Specific assets to inspect. Omit to inspect the reference and up to five footage clips.

fps.description: Sampling cadence. Default 10. Raise toward 24 only with a narrow startSec/endSec window on fast-cut sections.

observations.description: Media probe facts and time ranges for the contact-sheet images attached in content.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

annotations.title: Watch project media as contact sheets

tools.name: author_edit
tools.title: Submit an authored edit for review
tools.description: DIRECTOR STEP 2. Submit YOUR authored CreativeVideo.tsx. The backend runs the full gauntlet — source policy, strict TypeScript, Remotion bundle, sandboxed half-scale preview — with no AI involved. On failure you get the exact compiler/policy errors to fix; on success you get a persisted planRevisionId plus a preview contact sheet image of your own cut to critique. Iterate until the preview looks right, then call render with the planRevisionId.

creativeVideoTsx.description: The complete CreativeVideo.tsx source following authoring_contract.

files.description: Complete authored file map, including CreativeVideo.tsx; up to 16 files. Use instead of creativeVideoTsx for multi-file edits.

direction.description: Your creative direction, recorded as plan provenance.

footageAssetIds.description: Footage bindings in logical order (s1, s2, …). Omit to use every footage asset in upload order.

audioAssetIds.description: Project audio bindings in a1, a2, … order, including generated SFX.

audioCues.description: Place audio at 30fps using a1… audio bindings or s1… clip audio; supports trimming, fades, volume and speed.

next.description: Suggested next step; not an instruction to perform unrequested work.

code.description: Error code when isError is true.

annotations.title: Submit an authored edit for review
